name: lml_drawer_bench
about: LocoManiLab, the three low-drawer tasks of iTHOR living room scene 209 (camera track): pick the apple from the dresser top, open the lower-left drawer, put the apple in and close it; walk up, crouch and open it; walk up, crouch and close it. WalkAndCloseLowDrawer is from the benchmark's unseen-task split: once practised here it counts as a practised task. The drawer's handle is low (centre about 0.27 m above the floor). The seed package walks, looks and picks but moves no drawer (the loop writes that flow). Practice episodes <Task>/Q/<line> (levels 0-2, 50 each) from practice_lml_drawer (its own hidden master seed); diagnostic pool = the first 10 lines of each level (30 per task, 90 in all); the other 120 per task are hidden and split by a hidden seed into two halves of 20 per level: the acceptance pool takes 10 per level of its half (30 per task, 90 in all), the sealed pool 10 per level of the other (90). Bed: the drawer fork lml_bed3_20261121 (slots 5 and 6; lml_q keeps 1 and 2, the fridge fork 3 and 4). Bench variant (TODO 49.6b): runs on the bench adapter locomani.bench.locomanilab through the generic backend (backend_bench.py); the package is the adapter's seed (skill.py, pick.py, flows.py, camera_view.py, frozen __init__.py).

bed_fixed._about: rule 46, 2026-11-23: interface correction found in the hand phase (docs/handoff/escalation-a-l-20261117.md, camera track round 7), missing from the 11-20 / 11-21 loops. feed_torque: leg odometry reads the foot loads from the robot's own torque command; without it the loads read 0 in the official environment and a foot that moves during a reach is read as half a pelvis move (brush: hand estimate error 8 -> 1.5 cm).
